pix_family_appearance: Pix family appearance canon: Pix is a transgender man who can pass as human despite his visibly pointed, backward-swept ears. The childhood name 'Pix' came from those conspicuous ears, which his parents explained as an old inherited abnormality. Pix and his father have the tell-tale pointed ears. Pix's mother, Jacob and Clarahmizah have ordinary-looking human ears without points. Pix's mother eventually explains that much of the protector bloodline shared by her and Clarahmizah has Gandirosha and Zirramunis ancestry, and many descendants lost the conspicuous Aza'raan ear shape. Pix inherited the unmistakable ears through his father. The absence of pointed ears does not erase anyone's Aza'raan lineage or protector heritage.
